---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
# Read the tracking data, parse timestamps, and add date/season columns
mallards <- read_csv("data/mallards.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = ymd_hms(timestamp),
    month = month(timestamp, label = TRUE),
    month_num = month(timestamp),
    year = year(timestamp),
    season = case_when(
      month_num %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
      month_num %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
      month_num %in% 9:11 ~ "Autumn",
      month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter"
    ) |>
      factor(levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter"))
  )

write_rds(mallards, "data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
# Count GPS fixes per duck, sorted from most to least
mallards |>
  count(duck_id, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Summarize the geographic range (min and max latitude and longitude)
mallards |>
  summarize(
    min_lat = min(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_lat = max(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_long = min(long, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_long = max(long, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
# Load medium-resolution country outlines
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Filter GPS fixes to Central/Eastern Europe (47-55°N, 8-25°E)
mallards_region <- mallards |>
  filter(between(lat, 47, 55), between(long, 8, 25))

# Plot GPS fixes colored by duck over country outlines
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "grey95", color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(
    data = mallards_region,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, color = duck_id),
    size = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(8, 25), ylim = c(47, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard Duck GPS Fixes Across Central Europe",
    subtitle = "Filtered to 47–55°N, 8–25°E and colored by individual duck",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
